relevance.rationale: Genuine orphan; a doctoral thesis (123 pp.) on the motivic Galois action on motivic fundamental groups of punctured elliptic and rational curves, written in the motivic-correlator programme. Its Chapter 2 is 'Shuffle relations for Hodge and motivic correlators on P^1' — double shuffle relations on correlators — and §1.2.3 treats multiple polylogarithms; Chapter 3 relates Bianchi hyperbolic threefolds and modular complexes to the Galois Lie coalgebra, with §3.4.2 degenerating to Voronoi complexes and multiple zeta values. The folio has a specific open conjecture in this exact area: conj:qou-infra-discharges-goncharov-zeta5 proposes discharging the depth-3 motivic conjecture at Q(zeta_5), and its stated second route is to express the 22-term relation restricted to fifth roots of unity as an explicit element and kill it by Hecke normal-form reduction. Relations among Li_3 at roots of unity are what the shuffle machinery in Chapter 2 produces. Honest limits, and the reason this is not core: the thesis does not supply the 22-term relation at zeta_5, works mainly in weight <= 4, and I have not verified that its shuffle relations restrict usefully to fifth-root arguments. It is a technique source for an open conjecture, and should be cited as such rather than as a discharge.

keyResults.statement: General families of double shuffle relations on Hodge and motivic correlators on the punctured projective line, together with the correlator-to-multiple-polylogarithm dictionary and new functional equations on the Hodge correlator integrals.
keyResults.useForFolio: The relation-generating machinery the second route of conj:qou-infra-discharges-goncharov-zeta5 needs; also relevant to prop:depth-2-identification-bloch-suslin as the weight-3 continuation of the depth-2 story.

proposedActions.rationale: No ref() entry; the folio has an open conjecture explicitly in the depth-3 motivic programme at Q(zeta_5) and no registered source for the shuffle-relation machinery it proposes to use.

Before this is used for anything stronger, someone must check whether the double shuffle relations here actually restrict to fifth-root-of-unity arguments in weight 3 and generate relations independent of the multiplication formula the conjecture already quotients by. I did not verify that, so aid-proof would be an over-claim.
